---
description: "Basic instructions for creating automated tests."
applyTo: "**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx},tests/**/*.php"
---
# Basic Testing Instructions

- Add a test for every new or changed feature.
- Use Vitest and Testing Library for React tests.
- Put React tests next to the component in a `*.test.tsx` file.
- Use Pest for Laravel tests.
- Run `npm run test` before finishing.
